user.title: Create average sensor
user.description: Create a sensor that averages current source states or source history over a time window.

data_description.require_all_sources: Make the average unavailable if any source is unavailable or invalid.

data_description.start: Optional template that renders the start of the history range as a datetime or timestamp. Use with end or average window.
data_description.end: Optional template that renders the end of the history range as a datetime or timestamp. Use with start or average window. Leave empty to end at now.
data_description.scan_interval: Minimum time between history recalculations. Does not change how often the source devices report readings.
data_description.precision: Number of decimal places used for the sensor state.
data_description.duration: Leave empty to average current readings. Set a duration to average recorded readings over that window.
data_description.weights: Optional mapping of source entity IDs to weights, for example sensor.room_a: 2 and sensor.room_b: 1. Omitted sources use weight 1. Clear the mapping for equal weights.
data_description.max_source_age: Optional age limit based on the source last_updated time. Clear to disable. Strict mode requires every source to be fresh.
data_description.process_undef_as: Optional numeric substitute for undefined readings. Clear to omit undefined values. Never overrides Require every source.
data_description.ignore_undef: Allow averaging valid history intervals when the latest recorded reading is undefined. Does not override strict source availability.
data_description.calculate_to_now_undef: Assume the last valid reading continues through undefined history intervals. Requires Ignore undefined history intervals.

error.period_start_or_end_without_duration: Set an average window when using only start or only end.
error.too_many_period_options: Use no range, only an average window, or two of start, end, and average window.
error.no_sources: Select at least one source entity.
error.invalid_duration: Durations must be greater than zero. Clear an optional duration to disable it.
error.invalid_undefined_options: Extending the last known reading requires ignore_undef to be enabled.
error.invalid_weights: Use nonnegative numeric weights for configured source IDs, with at least one positive weight.

yaml_imported.title: Verify your imported Average Sensor configuration
yaml_imported.description:
Average Sensor YAML configuration has been imported into UI config entries.

1. Open **Settings > Devices & services > Integrations > Average Sensor**.
2. Verify the existing entity IDs, unique IDs, settings, units, recorder history and statistics are intact.
3. If you want to manage these sensors in the UI, comment out their **Average Sensor YAML definitions** after verification. Keep the commented definitions as a backup; do not delete or recreate the imported entries.

Active YAML is imported again on startup or YAML reload and can overwrite UI edits. If you prefer to manage a sensor from YAML, leave its definition active and make changes there.

The integration does not edit your YAML files. You can dismiss this notice after completing these checks.
